name: Insightful
summary: A work intelligence platform: workforce analytics plus AI process capture, covering time tracking, how work actually flows, and insider-threat detection as a paid add-on, priced per seat.
best_for: COOs, CFOs and operations leaders who want a work intelligence platform rather than a time clock: workforce analytics plus AI process capture (where the hours go, and how the work actually flows) across in-office and remote teams
skip_if: you value a low-surveillance culture, run a tiny team, or need People Intelligence on monthly billing (Insights requires annual billing as read 25 November 2026)
honest_knock: This is employee-monitoring software, so weigh the culture cost, not just the price: the published Analytics and Insights prices are per seat (read 25 November 2026), security features like insider-threat detection are a paid add-on, and monitoring tools can damage trust if rolled out without transparency.

pricing.entry_price_terms: per seat a month billed annually, or $10 on monthly billing (read 25 November 2026)
pricing.notes: (price re-verified 2026-09-09 against the vendor's own pricing page, re-read unchanged 2026-09-26) On the September readings, the plan cards showed Workforce Analytics at $8, Workflow Optimization at $12 and a $16 bundle. Pricing read 25 November 2026: Analytics costs $10 per seat per month on monthly billing or $8 per seat per month billed annually. The FAQ says the monthly rate drops to $8 after six months. Insights adds People Intelligence at $24 per seat per month, billed annually, with a 50-seat minimum. Intelligence adds Process Intelligence and is annual only, with a custom quote. Add-ons: Workspace Security $4/seat/mo (includes SSO and audit logs), screen recording $4, on-demand screenshots $4, higher-frequency screenshots $3 (up to 120 an hour), data-warehouse integration $0.50 for the whole bundle of custom API access, BigQuery and Snowflake. The September FAQ described a 7-day trial without Automatic Time Mapping. The current pricing FAQ lists a free Analytics trial without a credit card and a Work Audit for Insights and Intelligence. Admin, manager and client users are not billed unless you also track them, and users added mid-cycle are prorated. In September the FAQ listed a 250-licence minimum for on-premise deployment. That September reading also noted a '7-Day ROI Promise', a conditional offer whose only remedy is a 30-day service credit.

compare_with.name: Time Doctor
compare_with.why: The set buyers actually weigh this against is ActivTrak, Teramind, Hubstaff and Time Doctor: workforce-analytics tools, not shift-scheduling apps. Time Doctor is the established time-tracking incumbent; Insightful leans into workforce analytics and workflow optimization on a similar per-seat model, so decide on features and how much monitoring your culture can carry. Of that set we have reviewed Hubstaff so far.
